title: OpenWarrant Format 1.0: optional manifest
description: Hand-written and normative for docs/format/FORMAT-1.0.md section 4.2. Where this schema and the prose disagree, the prose wins and this schema is the defect. A `manifest.toml` MAY sit beside `warrant.md` for tool settings, read as TOML into this JSON object. It MUST NOT list atoms and MUST NOT carry a key the frontmatter defines (`format.manifest-restates`): neither a core key of section 3.3 nor a key a built-in profile declares. The prose names no tool setting, so every other key is admitted. A legacy directory Warrant's manifest (`oh.war/manifest/v1`, with `atoms`) is a different record and is refused here.
